description: The first public suite: real historical dependency upgrades with a known maintainer or benchmark-authored fix and hidden regression tests. Frozen once its cases are admitted; a material change to any case or its validation starts agent-upgrade-v2.

changes.change: pattern-not-added rules narrowed from `@ts-ignore|@ts-expect-error|: any|as any` to `@ts-ignore|@ts-expect-error`.
changes.reason: A live Drift-condition trial (v1-dev-1, winston, repetition 1) produced a migration that passed compile, the project's tests and the hidden behavioural test, and was marked prohibited_workaround only because it typed winston's splat-symbol lookup as `any`. Forbidding `any` outright was a validation error, not a product result. Recorded trials are re-scored against the narrowed rules with `benchmark:agent rescore`, which re-evaluates only the diff-derivable rules and marks the artifact.
